input.summary: The user asks whether the delay threshold is 0.2 seconds or 0.2 milliseconds. Note: 0.2 seconds = 200 ms and 0.2 milliseconds = 0.2 ms — these are genuinely different values. The source unit must be resolved before a threshold can be set, as the runner records flow_completion_time_ms in ms and the correct numeric threshold depends entirely on which unit the original claim intends.
clarification_questions: The claim mentions a 20 ms added delay — does the '0.2 seconds' figure in the paper refer to an expected or observed flow completion time threshold, or to the delay value itself? Please quote the exact sentence and units from the source.
Is '0.2 milliseconds' from your note also a flow completion time threshold, or is it a different quantity (e.g., one-way propagation delay, RTT, or something else)?
Should the delay be placed one-way (sender→receiver only) or round-trip (both directions) in the emulation? The runner requires an explicit placement declaration.
